newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Outpaced by NZ, not Canada.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Outpaced by NZ, not Canada.

text.p: Australian bonds showed a mixed performance against the dollar bloc, being strongly outpaced by New Zealand, but narrowing against Canada.

The market also showed a widening bias against the U.S. during a fairly slow local session ahead of the first of this week's key U.S. data later on Tuesday -- the first quarter employment costs index.
There is no major domestic data until Thursday's first quarter average weekly ordinary time earnings.

The long-end of the New Zealand market put in a strong rally, which traders there said was the unwinding of a curve steepening trade, taking its yield premium over Australia to its lowest level in nearly a month.
Meanwhile, the Canadian market was undermined again by a weakening Canadian dollar amid some jitters over the June 2 Canadian general election.
Canadian markets were unsettled by comments by Canadian Prime Minister Jean Chretien that he may reverse some planned spending cuts.
